title: Data Scientist Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on mathematics, statistics, programming, machine learning, experimentation, data engineering, model evaluation, and translating analysis into useful decisions.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish mathematics, statistics, programming, SQL and classical ML; Years 3–4 deepen machine learning, experimentation, deployment, domain knowledge and research-oriented project work.

blocks.label: Career progression

blocks.text: Typical years vary by organisation, domain and performance.
PhD routes

A durable Data Scientist profile combines statistical reasoning, machine learning, experimentation, data engineering and domain expertise. As automated modelling becomes more capable, emphasis should shift toward problem formulation, causal and experimental reasoning, trustworthy evaluation, model governance and communicating uncertainty to decision-makers.
